capabilities: display a heading minimap on the edge of the note
open a popover listing headings and open tasks
search, pin, and collapse or expand heading branches in the panel
jump to a heading by clicking it in the TOC
customize panel size, opacity, and H1-H6 badge colors
extras: README and plugin UI are bilingual (English/Chinese); the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: 本项目基于 xupisco/obsidian-suble-toc 进行修改与扩展。
problem: Long notes are hard to scan and jump around in; Obsidian's outline view doesn't provide an always-available floating minimap-style overview at the edge of the note.

relations.evidence: This project is modified and extended from xupisco/obsidian-suble-toc.

summary: Floating table-of-contents plugin that shows a heading minimap on the note edge and a popover with headings and open tasks.
